name: ml-engineer-strong
notes: Baseline strong-fit case against the real sampleresume.tex. PyTorch, imbalanced classification and pandas/numpy are explicit; Kubernetes and Go appear nowhere. Guards against both over-crediting (claiming k8s) and under-crediting (burying PyTorch).
jd:
Machine Learning Engineer (New Grad)

You will train and evaluate models on messy real-world data and ship them into production services.

Requirements:
- Python
- PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Experience with class-imbalanced datasets and appropriate metrics (recall, PR-AUC)
- pandas / NumPy
- SQL

Nice to have:
- Apache Spark
- Kubernetes
- Go
